treatmentJourney.title: Initial Consultation & Planning
treatmentJourney.description: We begin with a thorough examination, including 3D scans and digital X-rays, to assess your oral health and plan the optimal placement of your dental implants. Your personalized treatment plan will be discussed in detail.

treatmentJourney.title: Preparation Work
treatmentJourney.description: Any necessary preparatory steps, such as tooth extractions, bone grafting to ensure sufficient jawbone support, or gum care, will be completed to create a healthy foundation for your implants.

treatmentJourney.title: Implant Placement
treatmentJourney.description: The titanium implant post is precisely and surgically placed into your jawbone. This forms a stable foundation for your new tooth, mimicking the root of a natural tooth.

treatmentJourney.title: Healing & Osseointegration
treatmentJourney.description: A healing period of several months allows the implant to fuse with your jawbone through a process called osseointegration, ensuring a strong and permanent bond.

treatmentJourney.title: Abutment Placement & Impressions
treatmentJourney.description: Once osseointegration is complete, a small connector piece called an abutment is attached to the implant. We then take final impressions to design your custom crown, bridge, or arch.

treatmentJourney.title: Final Restoration & Care Plan
treatmentJourney.description: Your custom-fabricated crown, bridge, or full arch is securely attached to the abutment, completing your new smile. We will then provide you with a long-term care plan to maintain your implant.

faqItems.question: What is the process for dental implants?
faqItems.answer: The dental implant process typically involves an initial consultation, preparation work like extractions or bone grafting, surgical placement of the implant, a healing period, and finally, attachment of the permanent crown or bridge. We will guide you through each step.

faqItems.question: Do you offer financing options for dental implants?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we accept various payment methods including Cash, Check, Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and Care Credit. We are committed to making your dental implant treatment accessible and affordable.

faqItems.question: Am I a candidate for dental implants if I have bone loss?
faqItems.answer: Bone loss can sometimes affect candidacy for dental implants, but with modern techniques like bone grafting, many patients who have experienced bone loss can still receive implants. We offer initial consultations to assess your specific situation and recommend the best course of action.

faqItems.question: How long do dental implants typically last?
faqItems.answer: With proper care and maintenance, dental implants are designed to be a long-term solution and can last for many years, often a lifetime. Regular dental check-ups and good oral hygiene are key to their longevity.

faqItems.question: Is dental implant surgery painful and what sedation do you offer?
faqItems.answer: We prioritize your comfort with pain-free dental care and personalized treatment plans. While the surgery itself is performed under anesthesia, we also offer various sedation options to ensure you have a comfortable and relaxed experience during your procedure.

faqItems.question: How do dental implants compare to bridges or dentures for tooth replacement?
faqItems.answer: Dental implants offer a permanent and stable solution that acts like a natural tooth, preserving jawbone health and not relying on neighboring teeth for support. Bridges are fixed but require altering adjacent teeth, while traditional dentures are removable and may not offer the same stability as implants.
